A new module that reads Parquet files.

- `parquet-reader.wasm`: reads Apache Parquet files from data warehouses, data lakes and analytics tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Spark, DuckDB, Polars, pandas) into JSON records with column names and types. Files compressed with Snappy, Gzip, Zstandard, LZ4 or Brotli are supported, as are older Spark and Hive files (INT96 timestamps, two-level lists). Decimals stay exact, timestamps come out as ISO 8601, and nested lists, structs and maps become JSON arrays and objects. Pick columns and page through large files with `offset` and `limit`; row groups before the offset are skipped without being decompressed. Zstandard is decoded in pure Rust (ruzstd) through a small stand-in crate in `vendor/zstd-shim`.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
